hardening_history: The first complete run after the additive public export found only the expected stale contracts.py hash anchor; that single anchor was updated.
Adversarial review found generated dataclass initializers could be called directly on existing objects to rebind an observation or pair and could partially mutate after failed validation.

Both contracts were hardened with explicit validate-before-assignment single-use constructors; regression tests cover successful and failed observation rebinding plus pair replacement, reversal and mismatched-subject reinitialization.
Final independent adversarial and boundary audits found no semantic redesign or additional hardening requirement.
